_about: THE BATTERY IS REAL (ECONOMY TWO, 11/18/26; VAMILY rule 459, ask line 645). THE ONE TABLE for every number of batteries the game shows, pays or takes. Paolo 9/4: 'for one AA battery a bag of rice.' Paolo 11/17: 'some of the quests, it's like 3000 or like 1000 batteries to complete a quest and I'm like bro that's a lot... I want people to really feel like they can look at their battery right now and relate it from the game to real life.' THE AA IS THE UNIT. A sum is paid in the fewest kinds of battery, the biggest first: a car's battery, a tool pack, a phone's battery, AA's (the research, records/BOHEMIA_RESEARCH_HOW_MANY_BATTERIES_ARE_IN_THE_UNITED_STATES_11_17_26.md). HOW TO MOVE A PRICE: edit the number under 'rows', run `node tools/bohemia_economy_two_the_battery_table.js stamp`, then `check`. HOW TO ADD ONE: add its place to 'where' (a data file) or 'copies' (typed in code) in tools/bohemia_economy_two_write_the_table.py, run it, then `seed`. gates/the_battery_is_real_gate.js fails a number of batteries that is not here. MECHANISM-MINE / CONTENTS-PAOLO'S: every number carries where it came from; the words (the four names) are draft:true.

ladder.paid: fewest kinds, biggest first: car batteries, then tool packs; what is left under a tool pack is phone batteries when they make it exactly (6, 12, 18), else AA's
ladder.why_paid_so: every count on the glass is small (never more than 12 tool packs, 3 phone batteries, 19 AA's) and a sum is never more than three kinds; the prices were written in tens, and ten is ten AA's, not a phone battery and four
ladder.never: an electric car's pack (about 31,000 AA's) is not a thing a crew carries: nothing is priced in it. Who holds the working solar is NOT DECIDED (rule 459(e)): nothing here is built on it.

WHY: a standing price over a car battery is whole tool packs, so it is two kinds of battery on a small button, never three (300 was a car battery, two tool packs and ten AA's).
